prompt: Ask a question about the course {course}

entries.title: When is the deadline?
entries.answer: Finish Assertive at work within eight weeks of enrolment.

entries.title: Will I get a certificate?
entries.answer: Complete all six sections and the final action plan to download a completion certificate.

entries.title: How much time will I need?
entries.answer: Allow three hours in total, plus ten minutes a week to practise at work.

entries.title: Where can I get help?
entries.answer: Post in the course forum. The instructor replies within two working days.

entries.title: What does assertive mean?
entries.answer: Say what you need clearly while respecting the other person. Aggression uses threats or insults to get your way.

entries.title: What if someone talks over me?
entries.answer: Say: I would like to finish my point. Then pause and continue when you have the floor.

entries.title: How do I say no to extra work?
entries.answer: State your limit and offer a realistic alternative: I cannot take this on today. I can help on Thursday.

entries.title: What is a time-out?
entries.answer: Agree on a short break when a conversation gets heated. Say when you will return, then resume the conversation at that time.

seeds.question: Can I practise with a partner?
seeds.author: instructor
seeds.answer: Yes. Take turns making a request and giving feedback on how clear it was.

seeds.question: Do I have to share a real conflict?
seeds.author: instructor
seeds.answer: No. Use an invented situation if you prefer. Keep other people’s names out of your posts.

seeds.question: How do you practise when you feel nervous?
seeds.author: learner
seeds.answer: I tried my first request with a colleague I trust. That made the next one easier.
